name: Self-order idle dialog
describe: Idle-timeout dialog ("Still there?") shown by useIdleReset after 90 s without input: centred card on a blurred scrim, title and a full-width primary "I'm still here" button (py-3, text-base, font-medium).
Use on tablet and kiosk screens before the session resets. RTL is a kit extension (the source has no dir handling): the kit mirrors with logical properties and translates the fixed UI labels.
